summary: Iteration 7 (Backend tidy-up + Rent Yield + Weekly Digest + Shopping List) tests. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py. Full regression /app/backend/tests/ still green at 109/109. server.py is now 54 lines mounting /app/backend/routes/*; all previously-tested endpoints still respond correctly. GET /api/project now exposes refinance_ltv, refinance_rate and a rent_yield object with gross_yield/yield_on_cost/invested/refinance_amount/cash_left_in/monthly_mortgage/monthly_cashflow with correct math (refi = valuation*ltv/100, invested = purchase+total_budget, cash_left_in = invested-refi, monthly_mortgage = refi*rate/100/12). PUT /api/project accepts refinance_ltv & refinance_rate and recomputes rent_yield (verified LTV 75->80 flips refi 198750->212000; rate 5.5->6.0 updates monthly_mortgage). Public /api/share/{token} HTML includes id="rent-yield" + 'Rent & refinance' card when monthly_rent>0 and omits it when monthly_rent=0. GET /api/digest validates week 0..52 (422 outside), auth-required, returns Monday-based week_start, 6-day span, spend {total,receipts_total,receipts_count,payments_total,payments_count,top}, prev_spend, snags_fixed[], snags_opened, snags_open_now, milestones_done[], next_milestone; week=1 shifts the window back exactly 7 days; paid stage_payments within week are included in spend.payments_total. Shopping: POST /api/shopping persists item (checked=False, checked_at=None), blank name -> 400; POST /api/shopping/from-line-items creates one row per budget item, second call returns {added:0, skipped:N} (idempotent dedupe by line_item_id), empty list -> 400; PUT /api/shopping/{id} {checked:true} sets checked_at ISO string, {checked:false} clears it; DELETE /api/shopping/checked removes only checked rows; DELETE /api/shopping/{id} removes single row; items are scoped to active project (new project starts empty; items from one project never appear in another). Auth is required on all shopping endpoints. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844) walked end-to-end: logged in via Sign in -> auth-email-input/auth-password-input -> auth-submit-button -> home-screen. Dashboard shows digest-card (digest-card-spend/snags/milestones populated) and rent-yield-card (rent-gross-yield=6.1%, rent-cash-left-in=£34,750, rent-refi-amount=£198,750 at LTV 75). Tapped digest-card -> digest-screen, digest-week-label='This week', digest-prev-week shifts to 'Last week', digest-next-week returns to 'This week'. Tapped SectionTitle 'Edit' (rent-yield-edit) -> project-edit-screen, changed project-ltv-input to 80 and saved via project-save-button; home refetched and rent-refi-amount updated to £212,000; restored LTV to 75. Shopping flow: Budget tab shows shopping-list-banner -> shopping-screen (empty-state visible when no items). Tapped shopping-add-button -> shopping-add-screen (default 'From budget' mode), shopping-select-all picked 6 budget rows, shopping-add-save created 6 items, rows rendered as shopping-row-<id>. Tapped a row to tick it (shopping-clear-ticked button appeared), tapped clear-ticked and 1 ticked row was removed. Deleted the remaining rows via shopping-delete-<id>; final list = 0. State restored: demo project refinance_ltv=75, refinance_rate=5.5, monthly_rent=1350; shopping list cleared. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native issues: carry-over 'shadow* -> boxShadow' RN-Web deprecation warning in console (not introduced by this iteration).

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated; use boxShadow. Non-blocking RN-Web warning that pre-dates this iteration — unchanged by iteration 7.

action_items: No blockers. Iteration 7 (rent yield + digest + shopping list + server split) is production-ready.
(Carried over) RN Web shadow* -> boxShadow deprecation warning still present; harmless but worth migrating when touching style sheets.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 54 lines; routes split cleanly into /app/backend/routes/*.py with a single APIRouter(prefix='/api') aggregator — much more maintainable.
projects.rent_yield() correctly guards against divide-by-zero when estimated_valuation or invested is 0.

digest.week_bounds pins to Monday (today - today.weekday()); spend uses [start, end] inclusive date-strings for receipts and [start, end+1day) for stage_payments.paid_at (handles timestamps correctly).
shopping.from_line_items dedupes by (project_id, line_item_id) via a scoped find before insert_many — second call correctly returns added=0.
shopping.update sets checked_at = now_iso() when checked=True and None when False — matches test contract.
shopping delete endpoints are scoped to user_id (DELETE /shopping/{id} and /shopping/checked both filter on user_id). The 'checked' route is declared before '{sid}' so FastAPI picks the right match.
projects.delete_project also wipes db.shopping_items for the deleted project — no orphan rows after project deletion.
ProjectUpdate uses exclude_none so partial PUTs don't zero out other fields; good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (digest + rent-yield + shopping testIDs and flows verified end-to-end)
